mapper.select: SELECT d.date AS class_date, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cs.name ORDER BY s.period_start_time SEPARATOR ', ') AS subject_names FROM ( SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(#{today}) - 1) DAY), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS date UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(#{today}) - 1) DAY), INTERVAL 2 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(#{today}) - 1) DAY), INTERVAL 3 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(#{today}) - 1) DAY), INTERVAL 4 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(#{today}) - 1) DAY), INTERVAL 5 DAY) ) d LEFT JOIN course_schedule s ON s.course_id = #{courseId} AND s.class_date = d.date LEFT JOIN course_subject cs ON s.subject_id = cs.id GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date
